import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    G = np.tanh(params[0]*t)
    return (params[1]*G + params[2]*P*t + params[3]*P*G + params[4]*P + params[5]*P**2
            + params[6]*P**2*G + params[7]*P**3*G + params[8]*P**2*t + params[9]*P*t**2 + 0*P**3)
